title: Puthoff and Davis never shown AARO notes of their interviews

tellings.quote: I mean I think uh Hal Putoff and Eric Davis to this day have never been shown the notes from their meetings with Arrow.

plain: Kirk McConnell, a former US Senate staffer, says that two physicists, Hal Puthoff and Eric Davis, met with AARO, the Pentagon office set up in 2022 to look into UFO reports. According to McConnell, to this day neither man has been shown the notes the office took of those meetings. If true, it would mean the office's record of what they said cannot be checked by the people who said it.
